title: Rock Rats
tagline: Mining in a vector asteroid field: break the rocks, send limpets for the fragments, bank a full hold.
description: Break big rocks into smaller rocks, and every break shakes fragments loose. Send a collector limpet for each one: gravel is worth little, blue pristine rocks give more, and the glowing cores are worth the trip. A full hold banks with a bonus; lose the ship and the hold goes with it. Now and then a pirate arrives to take it: a Sidewinder, or a Viper that's harder to shake.
